title: UniversalOps Jira Ticket Spec — Complete Project Timeline
description: Single source of truth for all ~100 Jira tickets. Generated 2026-07-30 from ROADMAP.md, plan files, ADRs, and repo memory. For team-managed (simplified) KAN project — Epic-child links use parent field, not customfield_10014.

meta.teamManagedConstraint: Use parent.key for Epic-child linking. Fields like customfield_10014 (Epic Link) are NOT available in team-managed projects.
meta.labelConstraint: Team-managed projects require flat string arrays. JSON add/remove syntax does not work.

epics.description: Multi-phase performance optimization plan covering batch collection, efficient polling, and frontend rendering. See docs/plans/2026-07-20-performance-optimization-roadmap.md and ADR-0003. Four phases: Batch Collection (pipeline batching), Smart Polling (adaptive intervals), Frontend (memoization, virtualization), and Transport (binary serialization).

children.description: Implement batch collection in internal/common/pipeline.go where collectors emit batches instead of single events.
Implement adaptive polling intervals — slow polling for stable metrics, fast polling for volatile metrics.
Virtual scrolling for large tables, memoization of expensive Recharts renders, React.memo on collector cards.
Replace JSON with protobuf/flatbuffers for Wails bridge calls with large payloads.

epics.description: Achieve 80%+ coverage across all subsystems. Add unit tests, integration tests, and maintain the E2E test harness. See plans/2026-07-24-sprint-ci-cd-and-test-audit.md and coverage/ summaries.

children.description: Add unit tests for CPU, memory, disk, process, and network collectors in internal/sysops/. Target: 80%+ coverage.
Add unit tests for DNS resolution, latency checks, port scanning, and topology discovery. Target: 80%+ coverage.
Add unit tests for port scanning, firewall rule analysis, process ancestry checks, and listening endpoint enumeration. Target: 80%+ coverage.
Add unit tests for Docker stats, container lifecycle, and compose parsing. Target: 80%+ coverage.
Add unit tests for analyst engine, anomaly detection, state queries, and workflow evaluation. Target: 80%+ coverage.
Add unit tests for Pipeline, Storage, Alerts, Sandbox, and SLO services. Target: 80%+ coverage.
Add tests for all Wails bound facades in internal/app/. Covers error handling, input validation, and panic recovery.
Add Vitest + React Testing Library tests for key UI components: dashboard, collector cards, charts, settings panels.
Keep run_e2e_tests.py working with current collector interfaces. Add new E2E scenarios for cross-subsystem flows.

epics.description: Extend AI capabilities beyond Ollama. Multi-model provider support, predictive analytics, natural language system query, and automated RCA report generation. See ADR-0005 and internal/aiops/. Also covers the MCP server in internal/aiops/mcp/.

children.description: OpenAI/Anthropic API integration alongside existing Ollama support. Provider abstraction layer with fallback.
Trend forecasting for disk, memory, CPU utilization using linear regression or simple time-series models.
Ask questions about system state in plain English. LLM translates to structured queries against collector data.
Scheduled root cause analysis digests from anomaly data and system logs.
Extend internal/aiops/mcp/ with additional tools/resources for collector data access and alert management.

epics.description: Active sprint (2026-07-28). Focus on completing the 80% implementation and shipping surface-level improvements. See plans/2026-07-28-sprint-surface-and-polish.md.
Long-term platform expansion: plugin system for community-contributed collectors, remote lightweight agent for headless servers, mobile companion app (read-only), and optional web UI mode.

children.description: Community-contributed collectors and analyzers via a plugin SDK. Go plugin or WASM-based extension architecture.
Small-footprint collector daemon for monitoring headless servers. Forward metrics to main instance.
Read-only dashboard for iOS/Android. Push notifications for critical alerts.
Optional web-based interface for browser access. Wails serve mode or separate web server.

epics.description: User-facing features for v1.4.0: custom dashboard layouts, configurable alert rules engine, export/reporting, and multi-workspace support.

children.description: Drag-and-drop widget arrangement using react-grid-layout or custom implementation. Layout persisted to SQLite per workspace.
User-configurable threshold-based alerts (CPU > 90%, disk > 95%) with desktop notifications via Wails notification API.
PDF/CSV export for dashboard metrics and system reports. Client-side generation from Recharts data.
Create and switch between multiple system profiles. All collector state scoped to active workspace. SQLite model.

epics.description: Security feature expansion: file integrity monitoring (hash-based change detection), local CVE vulnerability scanning, and CIS benchmark compliance reporting.

children.description: Hash-based (SHA-256) change detection on critical system files. Baseline snapshot with periodic verification.
Match installed software against local CVE database. Offline-compatible with periodic update.
CIS benchmark checks for Windows/Linux with pass/fail scoring and remediation guidance.

epics.description: Platform infrastructure for v1.4.0: macOS code signing, Linux AppImage packaging, auto-update mechanism, and performance profiling with pprof.

children.description: Full notarization pipeline in CI. Apple Developer certificate managed in secrets. Use gon or xcrun altool.
AppImage distribution for broader Linux support. appimagetool or linuxdeploy in release workflow.
In-app update checker via GitHub Releases API. One-click download. Manual opt-in on first launch.
pprof HTTP endpoint in debug mode. Flamegraph export. Documented in developing.md.

epics.description: Long-term ecosystem vision: community marketplace for dashboards/alerts/workflows, REST API gateway for third-party integration, and team collaboration with role-based access.

children.description: Share and discover custom dashboards, alert rules, and workflows. Local registry with import/export.
REST API for third-party integration and automation. API key authentication with scoped permissions.
Shared workspaces with role-based access. Multi-user support on shared infrastructure.

epics.description: Complete CI/CD infrastructure: cross-platform test matrix, release automation with artifact publishing, Codecov integration, dependency updates via Dependabot, and contributing guidelines. See plans/2026-07-24-sprint-ci-cd-and-test-audit.md.

children.description: GitHub Actions matrix across ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest. Go build + test + vet on all three.
Upload coverage reports to Codecov. Status check on PRs. Coverage targets per package.
Automated dependency update PRs for Go modules and npm packages. Weekly schedule.
GitHub Actions release workflow triggered by tags. Build, sign, package, and publish across all platforms.
SHA-256 checksum generation and GPG signing for all release artifacts.
CONTRIBUTING.md, PR template, issue templates for bug reports and feature requests.
golangci-lint run in CI. ESLint for frontend. Block PRs on lint failures.

epics.description: Network feature expansion: integrated pcap viewer with protocol dissection, per-process bandwidth monitoring, and VPN detection with routing table audit.

children.description: Integrated pcap analysis with protocol dissection. Load and browse captures in-app.
Track network usage per process. Real-time and historical views.
Tunnel interface identification and routing table analysis. Detect active VPN connections.

bulkCreateInstructions: Call mcp_atlassian-mcp_createJiraIssue for each item. For Epics: issueTypeName='Epic'. For children: issueTypeName='Task', parent='KAN-X'. Use labels array for tagging. Team-managed project constraint: DO NOT use customfield_10014 — use parent.key instead.
